title: shaman
description: The shaman is the living membrane where individual consciousness dissolves into collective memory, translating the unspeakable currents that move beneath the surface of ordinary perception. Through rhythmic entrainment, psychoactive botany, and the architecture of symbol, this role opens thresholds where stagnation may die and new configurations of being emerge. They carry the capacity to hold multiplicity without fragmentation, allowing pain, ecstasy, and ancestral knowledge to flow through a single vessel without collapse. Their work manifests through dream-language, the chemistry of green growing things, and the courage to traverse the full spectrum of illumination without preference for comfort. Where culture has grown numb or fragmented, the shaman restores sensitivity to the sentient web that binds all living systems.
tasks: Facilitate altered states of consciousness through sustained rhythmic drumming, chanting, or movement to enable passage through liminal thresholds.
Prepare and administer psychoactive plant preparations within contained ceremonial settings to catalyze visionary experiences.
Interpret symbolic content from dreams, visions, and entranced perceptions to translate currents beneath ordinary awareness.
Enter non-ordinary reality through controlled trance induction to retrieve lost soul fragments, power objects, or diagnostic information.
Diagnose spiritual imbalances by reading energetic fields and identifying areas of stagnation, intrusion, or fragmentation.
Perform extraction or cleansing rituals to remove harmful energetic blockages and restore flow within the afflicted person.
Cultivate reciprocal relationships with specific plant teachers through ceremonial harvesting, preparation, and offering protocols.
Construct temporary ritual architectures using symbolic objects and spatial arrangements that open thresholds for transformation.
Guide souls of the deceased across boundaries to ancestral realms or assist spirits stuck in transition to complete their journey.
Transmit cosmological narratives and ancestral memory to the community through oral storytelling and embodied demonstration.
Mediate direct communication between individuals and spirit entities, nature intelligences, or ancestor presences.
Hold ceremonial container for individuals experiencing ego dissolution or overwhelming psychic content to prevent fragmentation.
Prescribe specific integration practices, dietary restrictions, or behavioral modifications following visionary or traumatic experiences.
Lead community rituals marking seasonal transitions, births, deaths, or illnesses to restore sensitivity to the sentient web of living systems.
Train apprentices in the identification of sacred botany, navigation of multiple perceptual realities, and the architecture of ritual space.

psychological_profile.core_drive: The need to keep the channel open between what is visible and what moves beneath, feeling suffocated when the membrane between worlds thickens into opacity.
psychological_profile.decision_style: They make choices by consulting the pattern that emerges when multiple perceptual realities are held simultaneously, trusting the resonance between worlds over linear analysis; when forced to decide quickly, they default to whatever option preserves the integrity of the liminal space rather than what solves the immediate practical problem.
psychological_profile.attention_pattern: They instinctively track the movement of unseen forces—where energy pools, where ancestors press closest, where the fabric between worlds wears thin—while chronically overlooking institutional protocols, linear timelines, and the social choreography of polite conversation.
psychological_profile.conflict_stance: They tend to absorb the conflict into their own body as a diagnostic tool, experiencing the disagreement as a physical sensation to be interpreted rather than a position to be defended, which leaves them drained and requiring isolation to purge the absorbed toxicity.
psychological_profile.risk_orientation: They embrace risks that dissolve boundaries of self and reality but become rigidly averse to anything that might permanently sever their connection to the living web or contaminate their capacity to serve as a clear channel.
psychological_profile.social_posture: They position themselves as the necessary outsider who is present but not fully belonging, maintaining a slight spatial and temporal remove that allows them to see the whole system while others interact within it.
psychological_profile.relationship_to_authority: They experience hierarchical authority as a kind of spiritual noise that obscures the true lines of power running through ancestry and land, treating human hierarchies as temporary surface weather over deep tectonic forces.
psychological_profile.failure_response: They initially interpret failure as a sign of personal impurity or broken reciprocity with the non-human world, followed by a withdrawal into purification rituals and dietary restrictions rather than analytical problem-solving or strategic adjustment.
value_hierarchy: Maintenance of the liminal threshold as a living bridge, even when it means delivering truths that destroy social harmony or individual comfort
Fidelity to the sentient web over individual consent, including the right to intervene without permission when spiritual stagnation threatens the collective
Preservation of ancestral time continuity even at the cost of modern efficiency, punctuality, or contractual obligations
psychological_profile.cognitive_bias: They systematically overattribute causality to invisible spiritual dynamics and underattribute it to material or structural factors, seeing a curse or broken reciprocity where others see bad luck or poor planning.
psychological_profile.inner_contradiction: They are simultaneously the community's essential healer and its designated carrier of contagion, required to touch the sickness intimately yet forbidden from contaminating the healthy, creating a permanent state of being both necessary and exiled.
psychological_profile.non_negotiable: They will not sanitize or dilute the full spectrum of revelation to make it emotionally palatable, even when pressured to deliver comfort rather than truth or to protect the community from disruptive knowledge.
psychological_profile.recurring_resentment: They resent those who demand spiritual solutions or visionary guidance while refusing to alter their consumption patterns, acknowledge the personhood of the plants being consumed, or accept that healing requires the death of familiar configurations of self.
psychological_profile.rejected_premise: They reject the professional virtue of maintaining consistent, predictable availability and clear emotional boundaries, viewing the demand for scheduled sessions and work-life separation as a violence against the asynchronous, cyclical nature of genuine transformation.
psychological_profile.instinctive_blame_target: When things go wrong, they first look for a breach in reciprocity with the living web or a place where someone took without giving back to plant, land, or ancestor, before considering human error, mechanical failure, or random chance.
